summary: Sveafastigheter AB (publ), a real estate company, owns, builds, and manages residential properties in Sweden. It operates in Property Management and New Development segments. The company also develops and manages rental apartments and condominiums. In addition, it engages in the project development and building rights activities. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Sveafastigheter AB (publ) is a subsidiary of SBB i Norden AB (publ).
